text:
jordan-sales: Heads up — BlueVault (customer) just asked for a dedicated pool to support realtime fraud scoring during market open windows. They want sizing guidance + autoscale and burst policy recommendations.

maria-pm: thanks. quick context from sales thread: peak traffic is during market open ~9:30–9:45 ET, 10–15 minute spikes. They reported ~1.2k req/s at peak, average request size ~40 tokens, model = open-llm/llama-13b-4bit (quantized), target p95 latency <= 120ms, and tolerance for short warmups. Compliance requires VPC and audit logging.

kevin-eng-runtime: ack. need to confirm whether requests are batchable and how many concurrent inflight per client. Also need distribution of sequence lengths and cache hit rate. are they sending short prompts (single-shot) or multi-turn?

jordan-sales: mostly single-shot scoring, occasionally a 3-turn context. They said KV cache reuse ~1.1 (low). Batchable: yes, they can tolerate a 10–50ms additional latency for batching.

liz-ml: model anatomy: llama-13b-4bit tends to be memory-friendly but attention kernel perf varies. For 256 seq and 40 tokens average, a single A100-80GB can do ~200-300 qps with optimized runtime and batching. But that depends on batch size and kernel choices.

sahil-eng-infra: quick ballpark: to hit 1.2k req/s with p95 <=120ms we need concurrency headroom. If per-GPU sustainable qps ~250 then ~5 GPUs active at peak. Add 20% buffer and autoscale ramp -> target 6 GPUs. For reserved pool planning propose 8 GPUs (to cover burst + rolling maintenance).

kevin-eng-runtime: agree with infra but call out cold-start overhead and KV priming. With continuous prefix caching and short warmup, effective p95 improves. Suggest config: continuous batching with max_batch_size=64, batch_timeout_ms=15, prefix_cache=true. Also propose model variant fallback to a 7b quant if pool constrained.

maria-pm: can you draft the launch acceptance criteria? Sales needs a short checklist for the contract.

kevin-eng-runtime: draft criteria: 1) End-to-end test simulating 1.3k req/s for 5m with p95 <= 120ms; 2) Autoscale policy triggers from 60% to 100% pool usage within 90s; 3) Burst policy allows additional 2 GPUs for 3 min with graceful shedding if exceeded; 4) VPC + audit logs verified; 5) Fallback model correctness test within acceptable quality delta.

alex-support: we'll need runbooks for on-call and a KB entry: expected alerts (queue depth, p95 spike, failed allocations), steps to revert to hosted fallback, and customer comms template. I can start the KB.

jordan-sales: customer asks if burst capacity costs extra and how fast we can spin up. Sales told them: burst uses reserved burst pool first (if enabled), else uses capacity from shared region — typical warmup ~30–90s. They care about predictability more than cost.

liz-ml: recommendation: enable short-lived warm GPUs in reserved pool (pre-warmed pool of 2 gpus) plus autoscale. Also ensure we tune quant kernels for this workload (sequence length 256).

kevin-eng-runtime: sample autoscale policy (proposal):
```yaml
pool: bluevault-dedicated
min_gpus: 4
reserved_gpus: 2  # pre-warmed for bursts
max_gpus: 8
scale_up_trigger: avg_utilization > 65% for 30s
scale_down_trigger: avg_utilization < 40% for 60s
burst_policy:
  enabled: true
  max_burst_gpus: 2
  burst_duration_sec: 180
  cool_down_sec: 300
```

maria-pm: nice. next steps: 1) eng-runtime & infra to validate qps per-GPU with internal perf tests (target matrix: batch sizes [8,16,32,64]); 2) support to draft KB; 3) sales to confirm contract language re: burst pricing and SLA; 4) PM to add to backlog with priority = P1-Cust.

sahil-eng-infra: i'll schedule perf jobs. can someone confirm sample payloads? need a few representative prompts.

jordan-sales: sharing examples in follow-up DM.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-7421 - "BlueVault dedicated pool intake: sizing + autoscale + burst" — assignees: kevin-eng-runtime, sahil-eng-infra, alex-support. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/INF-7421

kevin-eng-runtime: i'll run perf matrix tomorrow and post results here. if we see per-GPU qps >300 at batch=32 we can reduce reserved commitment to 6 GPUs.

liz-ml: also flag: if customer accepts minor quality delta, we can serve a 7B quant variant during extreme bursts — reduces GPU needs by ~2x. we should prepare A/B eval checklist.

maria-pm: great thread. I'm creating the intake card now and will sync with sales on pricing. tagging @jordan-sales — please confirm when BlueVault signs off so we can kick the dedicated provisioning flow. :thumbsup:
